metadata.region: Sahara / Ouest du Grand Erg Oriental

companies.name: Coopérative des Palmeraies de El M'Ghair (COPEM)
companies.activity_description: Agricultural cooperative uniting over 500 date palm farmers in El M'Ghair region. Provides collective marketing, processing support and export facilitation for member producers of the wilaya.

companies.name: Pépinière des Palmiers du Sud - El M'Ghair (PPS-EM)
companies.activity_description: Date palm nursery producing quality offshoots and tissue-cultured plants. Specializes in disease-resistant varieties suited to Saharan conditions. Serves replanting programs across southern Algeria from El M'Ghair base.

companies.name: Société de Conditionnement et d'Export des Dattes (SCED-EM)
companies.activity_description: Major date processing and export company based in El M'Ghair specializing in Deglet Nour dates from local oasis groves. Modern processing facility with sorting, grading and packaging lines for international markets.

companies.name: Dattes du M'Ghair Premium (DMP)
companies.activity_description: Specialized date company focusing on high-quality hand-selected Deglet Nour from traditional family groves around El M'Ghair. Direct farm-to-market approach with organic options and premium packaging.

companies.name: Unité de Transformation des Produits Phoénicoles (UTPP)
companies.activity_description: Agro-food processing facility producing value-added date products including paste, syrup, vinegar, powder and confectionery ingredients. Supplies food industry across Algeria and exports to international markets.

companies.name: Établissement Haddad pour Commerce Général (EHCG)
companies.activity_description: Major trading company in El M'Ghair handling import-export operations, general commerce, agricultural products distribution and equipment supply for the Sahara region. One of oldest commercial establishments.

companies.name: Coopérative Artisanale des Tapis de Djemorah (CATD)
companies.activity_description: Artisanal cooperative preserving traditional carpet weaving heritage of Djemorah region. Members produce hand-woven carpets, rugs and textiles using traditional patterns and techniques passed through generations. Famous for distinctive designs.

companies.name: Atelier de Tisserand Traditionnel ATT-Djemorah
companies.activity_description: Master weaver workshop producing authentic hand-woven rugs using ancestral techniques. Preserves distinctive Djemorah designs featuring geometric patterns inspired by oasis life and desert motifs. Award-winning artisan.

companies.name: Élevage Moderne Saharien - El M'Ghair (EMS-EM)
companies.activity_description: Modern livestock operation combining traditional Saharan pastoral practices with contemporary animal husbandry techniques. Specializes in sheep breeding (taadnit variety), camel husbandry and fodder cultivation for regional markets.

companies.name: Société d'Exploitation des Phoénicoles M'Ghair (SEPM)
companies.activity_description: Company specialized in date palm grove management providing technical services including pollination, harvesting, pest management (boufaroua treatment), pruning and grove rehabilitation for palm owners across El M'Ghair wilaya.

companies.name: Transport Logistique M'Ghair (TLM)
companies.activity_description: Logistics and transport company operating in El M'Ghair with fleet serving local businesses, date exporters and cross-border trade routes to Libya via Debila corridor. Refrigerated transport capability for date exports.

companies.name: Huilerie de Noyaux de Dattes El M'Ghair (HNDEM)
companies.activity_description: Modern oil pressing facility producing high-quality date seed oil (huile de noyau de datte), olive oil and other vegetable oils. Utilizes contemporary extraction technology while maintaining traditional quality standards. Cosmetic-grade production.

companies.name: BTP M'Ghair Construction (BTP-MG)
companies.activity_description: Construction company serving El M'Ghair wilaya with expertise in residential, commercial and public infrastructure projects. Specializes in traditional vault architecture (koubba) adaptation for modern buildings suited to Saharan climate.

companies.name: Matériels Agricoles du M'Ghair (MAM)
companies.activity_description: Agricultural equipment supplier serving the El M'Ghair farming community. Imports and distributes irrigation systems (goutte-à-goutte), farm machinery, greenhouse equipment, date processing machinery and spare parts.

companies.name: Société de Tourisme Oasien M'Ghair (STOM-G)
companies.activity_description: Tourism operator specializing in desert excursions, oasis visits and cultural tourism in the El M'Ghair region. Offers packages featuring traditional architecture, palm grove tours, thermal spring visits and Sahara experiences unique to this area.

companies.name: Agence de Voyages Sahara M'Ghair (AVSM)
companies.activity_description: Travel agency organizing desert tourism packages, pilgrimage travel (Hajj/Umrah), domestic tourism and business travel services from El M'Ghair. Licensed operator with experienced guides familiar with Sahara terrain and Libyan border routes.

companies.name: Commerce Général Zeribet El Omar (CGZO)
companies.activity_description: Wholesale and retail trading company operating in Zeribet El Omar commune. Handles general merchandise, food products, household goods, livestock feed and supplies smaller retailers throughout the eastern part of El M'Ghair wilaya.

companies.name: Station Service et Carburants du Sud - M'Ghair (SCSM)
companies.activity_description: Fuel distributor operating service station in El M'Ghair city. Supplies gasoline, diesel, lubricants and fuel oil to vehicles, agricultural machinery (pumps, tractors), transport trucks and industrial customers in the wilaya.

companies.name: Société Froid et Climatisation M'Ghair (SFCM)
companies.activity_description: HVAC company installing and servicing refrigeration systems, air conditioning units and cold storage facilities in El M'Ghair. Critical partner for date preservation requiring temperature-controlled environments in Saharan climate conditions.

companies.name: Ferme Intégrée Oasis M'Ghair (FIOM)
companies.activity_description: Integrated farm practicing modern oasis agriculture combining date palms with vegetable crops under shade structures, fruit trees (pomegranate, fig, grape) and fodder production. Uses efficient drip irrigation and sustainable practices adapted to arid environment.

companies.name: Société d'Électrosoudage et Métallerie M'Ghair (SEMM)
companies.activity_description: Metal fabrication workshop serving industrial, construction and agricultural sectors in El M'Ghair. Produces custom metalwork, gates, fencing, storage tanks, irrigation pipe systems, cold room structural components and general welding services.

companies.name: Dattes & Délices du Désert (DDD)
companies.activity_description: Premium date brand specializing in gourmet date products for retail and gift markets from El M'Ghair. Offers luxury packaging, chocolate-covered dates, stuffed dates (almond, walnut), date confectionery and corporate gift solutions made with local dates.

companies.name: Imprimerie Rapide M'Ghair (IRM)
companies.activity_description: Print shop offering digital printing, offset printing, graphic design and signage services for businesses in El M'Ghair. Produces business cards, letterheads, promotional materials, labels for date products and administrative documents.

companies.name: Pharmacie Centrale de El M'Ghair (PCEM)
companies.activity_description: Wholesale pharmaceutical distributor supplying medications, medical supplies and parapharmacy products to pharmacies and health facilities across El M'Ghair wilaya. Critical healthcare logistics provider for remote Saharan communities.

companies.name: Laboratoire d'Analyses Agricoles M'Ghair (LAAM)
companies.activity_description: Testing laboratory providing quality control services for agricultural products especially dates and food products from El M'Ghair region. Offers microbiological testing, chemical analysis (sugar content, moisture), pesticide residue testing and export certification support.

companies.name: Services Informatiques M'Ghair (SIM-Tech)
companies.activity_description: IT services company providing computer maintenance, software installation, network setup, website development and digital solutions for businesses in El M'Ghair. Supports digital transformation of local businesses including date exporters.

companies.name: Location Matériel de Chantier M'Ghair (LMCM)
companies.activity_description: Equipment rental company serving construction sector in El M'Ghair. Rents excavators, backhoe loaders, generators, compressors, scaffolding and construction tools for building projects, infrastructure works and cold storage facility construction.

companies.name: Établissement Familial Benmoussa Dates (EFBD)
companies.activity_description: Family-owned date business established over two generations in El M'Ghair. Operates traditional palm groves producing premium hand-selected dates following ancestral methods. Known for exceptional quality Deglet Nour from old-growth palms.

companies.name: Coopérative Laitière de Zeribet El Omar (CLZO)
companies.activity_description: Dairy cooperative collecting milk from local herders (camel, goat, cow) in Zeribet El Omar area and producing fresh dairy products for regional consumption. Supports small-scale livestock keepers with fair prices and technical assistance.
